summary: Sampled prose is code-specific and bounded to OEM application. Corrected one pressure-comparison statement and surfaced one additional source temperature-unit conflict; polished four sampled descriptions. Batch38 sampled source checks required no factual correction. This is a bounded independent sample review, not certification of the whole corpus.

bodySamples.observation: Scope distinguishes generic relief activation from Mazda high-pressure detection; extraordinary source values are bounded and already needs-review.
Body distinguishes modeled-pressure, peak-timing and pressure-difference observations from direct compression diagnosis; professional deceleration verification boundary retained.
Body distinguishes electrical extremes from actual brake vacuum and avoids a claim that braking remains acceptable.
PCM summary versus originating ISG code and historical status are clearly separated.
Body maps generic solenoid C to CW6A-EL number 3 and limits valve-body advice to that transmission; corrected awkward search description.
Cell suffix and command state are preserved; 0.9 V is not presented as a manual cell-discharge target; corrected search description.
Corrected measured-pressure-versus-estimate wording while preserving scoped generic/OEM difference and professional regeneration boundary.
Body differentiates cylinder 3 ion feedback from a generic coil-C location and connects the P0303 branch to combustion diagnosis.
Added source temperature-unit conflict; existing valve-direction and generic/OEM conflicts remain explicit needs-review.
Body treats crankshaft behavior as indirect evidence, considers combustion alternatives and does not advise repeated unsafe road reproduction; corrected search description.
The :53 deployment-inhibited meaning is distinguished from the generic third-stage label; no extra inflator or safe handling assumption is invented.
Body retains separate :11/:13/:87/:96 meanings, exact component scope and an appropriate professional restraint-system boundary.
PCM summary is correctly separated from brake-unit suffixes and the C0519 type fault; no sensor replacement is inferred from an engine scan alone.
T1/T2 temperature values are kept separate from adjacent P1/P2 hydraulic-pressure rows and suffixes are retained.
Body retains the ACC-startup event and explicitly avoids borrowing neighboring numeric limits or provoking abnormal braking on a road.
Five-second fault and one-second recovery conditions are distinct; measurement-path alternatives and full professional isolation boundary are preserved.
Body distinguishes DVD/CD communication from disc-read failure and explicitly scopes USB supply/signal/shield references to the fitted system.
Body differentiates receiving an error status from losing messages and avoids a blanket reflash or controller replacement.
Body resolves generic module-B wording to the driver-door supply unit without asserting inevitable window, mirror or lock symptoms.
Physical IG1 feed and BCM-reported ignition state remain separate; no fuse/relay bypass instructions are given.

edits.before: The documented Mazda P0763 procedure covers shift solenoid C maps to number 3 in the CW6A-EL.
edits.after: Mazda's CW6A-EL procedure maps P0763 to shift solenoid number 3 and explains the electrical-fault diagnostic path.

edits.before: The documented Mazda P0DAD procedure covers cell balancing remains active when it was not requested.
edits.after: Mazda's P0DAD procedure identifies unintended battery cell balancing, with the suffix specifying the affected cell.

edits.before: The documented Mazda P2104 procedure covers mazda diesel idle-control diagnosis includes boost and vacuum faults.
edits.after: Mazda's P2104 diesel procedure includes boost-pressure, vacuum-control and oil-level checks beyond the generic forced-idle label.

edits.before: Mazda's SKYACTIV-D page describes intake shutter idle-air control and investigates unexpectedly high estimated exhaust or boost pressure under its specified operating conditions.
edits.after: Mazda's SKYACTIV-D page describes intake shutter idle-air control and evaluates exhaust or boost pressure at or above the PCM's estimated value under its specified operating conditions.

edits.before: The documented Mazda P3498 procedure covers cylinder 1 may fail to return from deactivation.
edits.after: Mazda's P3498 procedure investigates cylinder 1 failing to return from deactivation and distinguishes combustion faults from valve problems.

edits.before: Preconditions include engine speed at least 2,000 rpm, coolant at or below 65 °C and absence of specified valve and water-pressure sensor circuit codes. The page's valve open/close wording is inconsistent between sections, so this article does not infer a precise command-direction rule.
edits.after: Preconditions include engine speed at least 2,000 rpm and absence of specified valve and water-pressure sensor circuit codes. The source pairs a coolant limit of 65 °C with 140 °F, an inconsistent conversion that needs verification. Its valve open/close wording also differs between sections, so neither a temperature conversion nor a precise command-direction rule should be assumed from this page alone.

unresolvedLimitations.detail: Source prints unusually high93 MPa threshold and generic relief-activation identity is not established; factory authenticity at current OEM portal and calibration plausibility not independently resolved.
Source literally uses0.9 V cell-voltage wording; no independent battery-monitor specification resolves whether terminology is erroneous. Article does not present it as a physical balancing target.
Generic forced-idle label and OEM pressure/vacuum route differ; unusual transmission-state wording remains source-scoped.
Generic MIL-request versus OEM valve-performance naming, open/close command wording and65 °C/140 °F conversion remain unresolved.

boundedReviewLimits: Only the 20 named bodies were substantively read; only the 10 named code/source pairs received independent source verification.
Five body-only samples per batch were reviewed for clarity, scope, specificity and hazardous guidance; their technical details were not independently checked against source in this pass.
Mazda evidence is downloaded manufacturer HTML publicly mirrored at CHARM; no current VIN-specific OEM portal, bulletin supersession or vehicle configuration was verified.
MG evidence is the exact 727-page UK manual revision; per-build applicability remains unestablished and cannot be generalized to every MG4.
Source-review checked means support against the cited document, not mechanic approval or actual vehicle diagnosis.
No live vehicle tests,repair outcomes, publication, commits, shared source manifests orgenerated corpus reports were altered.
